unit.why: A single anecdote about R. Shlomo of Karlin losing devekut on a downhill ride and repenting by risking death at a border crossing, with a short moral at the end.

stories.start_quote: וכמו ששמעתי מאאמו״ר ז״ל שסיפר מהצ״ה
stories.end_quote: כי אז היה נמנע מלשמח הקב״ה
stories.summary_en: R. Shlomo of Karlin was interrupted in his devekut by fear of the bolting horses on a steep descent. As repentance he deliberately crossed a border where guards could shoot him, holding fast to devekut in mortal danger, and then ordered a stop so that customs would not be evaded.

quotes: היה מחזיק עצמו לבל להיות נפסק מדביקות ה׳
tags.why: The whole story turns on keeping unbroken cleaving to God.
